queries.title: Average rep gain per post per tag (more than 1000 questions)
queries.sql:
SELECT   t.tagName 
,       COUNT(*) as NrOfQuestions 
,       AVG(RepGain) as AvgRepGain
FROM    tags t
JOIN    posttags pt
ON      pt.tagid = t.id
JOIN    (
        SELECT  pp.id
        ,       SUM(case when v.votetypeid = 2 then 10
                         when v.votetypeid = 2 then -2
                         else null 
                    end) As RepGain
        FROM    posts pp
        JOIN    posts pa
        ON      pa.parentid = pp.id
        JOIN    votes v
        ON      v.postid = pa.id
        GROUP BY
                pp.id
        ) as pv
ON      pv.id = pt.postid
GROUP BY
        t.tagName
HAVING
        COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY
        AVG(RepGain) DESC

queries.description: A copy of http://odata.stackexchange.com/stackoverflow/s/88/users-with-more-than-10-duplicate-accounts with reputation included. I thought it would be interesting to see if the multiple accounts were being used to boost one.

queries.title: Compare Answers To Common Question Vs. Another User
queries.description: And updated query to the query "Jon Skeet comparison" that allows for comparison against any user.
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @UserId int = @p_UserId;
DECLARE @OpponentUserId int = @p_OpponentUserId;

with fights as (
  select myAnswer.ParentId as Question,
   myAnswer.Score as MyScore,
   opponentAnswer.Score as OpponentScore
  from Posts as myAnswer
  inner join Posts as opponentAnswer
   on opponentAnswer.OwnerUserId = @OpponentUserId and myAnswer.ParentId = opponentAnswer.ParentId
  where myAnswer.ownerUserId = @UserId and myAnswer.postTypeId = 2
)

select
  case
   when myScore > OpponentScore then 'You win'
   when myScore < OpponentScore then 'You lose'
   else 'Tie'
  end as 'Winner',
  Question as [Post Link],
  myScore as 'My score',
  OpponentScore as "Opponent's score"
from fights;

queries.title: Show the users in a specified reputation range, with ratio of answers accepted.
queries.description: Show the users in a specified reputation range, with ratio of answers accepted.
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @RepMin int = @p_RepMin
DECLARE @RepMax int = @p_RepMax

SELECT
    u.DisplayName, u.Reputation,
    u.Id,
    Count(a.ID) as AcceptCount,
    (SELECT Count(*) FROM Posts WHERE OwnerUserId = u.Id AND PostTypeId = 2) as AnswerCount,
    (CAST(Count(a.Id) AS float) / (SELECT Count(*) FROM Posts WHERE OwnerUserId = u.Id AND PostTypeId = 2) * 100) AS AcceptedPercentage
FROM
    Posts q
  INNER JOIN
    Posts a ON q.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id
  INNER JOIN
    Users u on u.Id = a.OwnerUserId
WHERE
    (u.Reputation >= @RepMin and u.Reputation <= @RepMax)
  AND
    a.PostTypeId = 2
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName, u.Reputation
ORDER BY AcceptedPercentage DESC

queries.title: Questions with more than two required tags (Meta sites only)
queries.description: Finds all questions with more than two of: [support], [discussion], [feature-request], [bug].
queries.sql:
WITH  more than two required tags (Meta sites only)
-- Finds all questions WITH more than two of: [support], [discussion], [feature-request], [bug].

WITH RequiredTagIds AS
(
    SELECT Id
        FROM Tags
        WHERE TagName IN ('support', 'discussion', 'feature-request', 'bug')
)
SELECT
    Id AS [Post Link],
    RequiredTagCount
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            p.Id,
            (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PostTags pt
                    WHERE
                        (pt.PostId = p.Id) AND
                        (pt.TagId IN (SELECT Id FROM RequiredTagIds))
            ) AS RequiredTagCount
            FROM Posts p
            WHERE p.PostTypeId = 1
    ) a
    WHERE RequiredTagCount > 2

  SVRatio = round(cast(p.Score as float)/cast(p.ViewCount as float),4),

  p.ViewCount Views,
  vt.Name "V Type",
  p.CreationDate

JOIN Votes v
ON p.Id = v.PostID
JOIN VoteTypes vt
ON v.VoteTypeID = vt.Id

WHERE 
  p.PostTypeId = 1
AND
  ViewCount > 0
AND
   p.CreationDate > '2011-01-01'

ORDER BY

vt.Name

    Round(100.0 * Count(CASE WHEN Score = 0 THEN 1 END) / Count(*), 1) AS [% score=0],
    Round(100.0 * Count(CASE WHEN Score = 1 THEN 1 END) / Count(*), 1) AS [% score=1],
    Round(100.0 * Count(CASE WHEN Score = 2 THEN 1 END) / Count(*), 1) AS [% score=2],
    Round(100.0 * Count(CASE WHEN Score = 3 THEN 1 END) / Count(*), 1) AS [% score=3],
    Round(100.0 * Count(CASE WHEN Score > 3 THEN 1 END) / Count(*), 1) AS [% score>3]
FROM Posts
WHERE PostTypeId = 1 AND AnswerCount >= 0
GROUP BY AnswerCount
ORDER BY AnswerCount

    SELECT Cast(Count(*) AS FLOAT) AS Count
    FROM Posts
    WHERE PostTypeId = 2
      AND CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
)
SELECT
  a.Authors AS [Authors],
  Count(*) AS [Answers],
  Round(Count(*) / (SELECT Count FROM TotalAnswers) * 100, 1) As [Percent]
FROM (
    SELECT
      PostId, Count(DISTINCT UserId) As [Authors]
    FROM PostHistory
    WHERE PostHistoryTypeId = 5
       OR PostHistoryTypeId = 2
    GROUP BY PostId
  ) AS a
INNER JOIN Posts p ON p.Id = a.PostId
WHERE p.PostTypeId = 2
  AND p.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
GROUP BY a.Authors
ORDER BY Authors

queries.title: Calculate the average percent of each user's questions that have been accepted, excluding those with 0% accept rate.
queries.description: Calculate the average percent of each user's questions that have been accepted, excluding those with 0% accept rate.
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(Round(t.Accepted * 100.0 / t.Total, 1)) AS [Percent],
    STDEVP(Round(t.Accepted * 100.0 / t.Total, 1)) AS [std dev]
  FROM
    (SELECT
         Count(a.Id) AS [Total],
         Sum(CASE q.AcceptedAnswerId WHEN a.Id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Accepted]
       FROM Posts AS a
         JOIN Posts AS q
           ON a.ParentId = q.Id
       WHERE q.postTypeId = 1 AND a.postTypeId = 2 AND a.OwnerUserId <> q.OwnerUserId
       GROUP BY a.OwnerUserId
   ) AS t 
  WHERE t.[Accepted] > 0

queries.title: it also returns tag count breakdown with question counts.
queries.description: Returns average number of tags per question on a site. Additionally it also returns tag count breakdown with question counts. Best viewed as "Text-only results"
queries.sql:
WITH  Counts as (
  select
    len(Tags) - len(replace(Tags, '<', '')) as Tags,
    count(*) as QuestionCount
  from Posts
  where PostTypeId = 1
  group by len(Tags) - len(replace(Tags, '<', ''))
  )
select
  cast(Tags as varchar) as [Tags per question],
  replace(convert(varchar, cast(QuestionCount as money), 1), '.00', '') as [Number of questions],
  convert (varchar, floor((QuestionCount * 100.0 / (select sum(QuestionCount) from Counts)))) as PercentOfQuestions
from Counts
union all
select
  'Avg = ' + cast((cast(sum(Tags * QuestionCount) as decimal) / sum(QuestionCount)) as varchar),
  'All = ' + replace(convert(varchar, cast(sum(QuestionCount) as money), 1), '.00', ''),
  null
from Counts

order by [Tags per question]

queries.title: How many upvotes and downvotes have I received?
queries.sql:
SELECT  
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UpVotes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DownVotes,
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS UpVotePercentage,
  (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS DownVotePercentage
FROM Votes a
  INNER JOIN Posts b
    ON 
      a.PostId = b.Id
      AND b.PostTypeId IN (1,2) -- Only questions and answers
WHERE 
  b.OwnerUserId = @UserId
  AND a.VoteTypeId IN (2,3) -- Only up and down votes

  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId

queries.title: Top 50000 users by mean answer score. Each answer's score is log normalized and truncated at 0 (no negatives). Results are smoothed by adding 5 fake answers with score 0
queries.description: - Each answer's score is log normalized and truncated at 0 (no negatives) - Results are smoothed by adding 5 fake answers with score 0 (there's a bayesian justification for this involving conjugate priors).
queries.sql:
SELECT  TOP 50000
    Users.Id,
    DisplayName,
    Reputation,
    Count(Posts.Id) AS Answers,
    AVG(Log(0.5 * (
      ((CAST(Score AS float) + 1.0) + 1.0) + 
      ABS((CAST(Score AS float) + 1.0) - 1.0)
    ))) * Count(Score) / (Count(Score) + 5) AS LogAverageAnswerScore
FROM Posts
    INNER JOIN Users ON Users.Id = OwnerUserId
WHERE PostTypeId = 2
GROUP BY Users.Id, DisplayName, Reputation
ORDER BY LogAverageAnswerScore DESC

WITH  singlePostUsers as 
(SELECT 
   owneruserid
FROM 
      posts p
GROUP BY

HAVING COUNT(ID) = 1)

     SUM(CASE WHEN Reputation < 15 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) Over15

     AndAComment

queries.title: Accepted answers that have the lowest score
queries.sql:
SELECT  q.pid as [Post Link], q.max_score, q.min_score, q.n_answers from
(SELECT p.id  as pid,
       min(a.score) as min_score,
       max(a.score) as max_score,
       max(c.score) as acc_score,
       count(a.id) as n_answers
from posts p
join posts a on a.parentid = p.id
join posts c on p.acceptedanswerid = c.id
group by p.id
) as q
where q.acc_score = q.min_score
and q.acc_score < q.max_score
order by q.max_score - q.acc_score desc

queries.title: Collelation of niche topics and good unanswered questions. In this case, a "useful, unanswered question" refers to an unanswered question with a score of 1 or more, at least one favorite, and that is not closed.
queries.description: In this case, a "useful, unanswered question" refers to an unanswered question with a score of 1 or more, at least one favorite, and that is not closed. This query looks at the least common tags of each of those questions. The point is to examine the correlation between niche topics (determined by the least common tags) and unanswered questions which seems to be helpful. In the results, "Count" refers to the number of times the specified tag is the least common tag in a useful, unanswered question; "TagCount" refers to the total number of all questions which reference the tag; "%" is the percentage of times the tag occurs as the least common tag of a useful, unanswered question.
queries.sql:
WITH  GUA as (  
  select
    p.Id as PostId,
    min(t.count) as MinTagCount,
    t.Id as TagId
  from Posts as p
  join PostTags as pt on p.Id = pt.PostId
  join Tags as t on pt.TagId = t.id
  where
    p.PostTypeId = 1
    and p.ClosedDate is null
    and p.Score > 0
    and p.AnswerCount = 0
    and FavoriteCount > 0
    
    group by p.id, t.id),

ASDF as (
  select
    PostId,
    TagId,
    t.TagName,
    Count
  from GUA

join Tags as t on GUA.TagId = t.id and GUA.MinTagCount = t.Count
)

select
  TagId,
  TagName,
  Count(TagId) as [Count],
  Min(Count) as TagCount,
  round(convert(decimal,Count(TagId)) / convert(decimal,Min(Count)),3) as [%]
from ASDF

group by TagId, TagName, Count

order by [%] desc, [count] desc, TagName asc

queries.title: Questions with answers that received lots of votes quickly
queries.sql:
SELECT  distinct p3.parentId  [Post Link]
FROM posts p3, (
  SELECT COUNT(*) [Limited Score],
         p.score  [Answer Score],
         p2.score [Question Score],
         p.id, -- [Post Link], 
         p.owneruserid -- [User Link]
  FROM votes v, posts p, posts p2
  WHERE v.voteTypeId = 2 -- only look at upvotes
  AND v.postid = p.id
  AND p.parentid = p2.id
  AND v.creationDate - p2.creationDate 
      < @DaysThreshhold --only count votes within two weeks of post
  GROUP BY p.id, p.owneruserid, p.score, p2.score
  HAVING COUNT(*) > @ScoreThreshhold   
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) desc
  ) z
WHERE z.id = p3.id

 select a.Reputation,

queries.title: Most popular questions one has answered to.
queries.description: This is to know what are the most popular questions you have answered to. It also computes the percentage of people who has viewed the question that have upvoted your answer.
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @UserId int = @p_UserId;


select 
  answer.ParentID as [Post Link],
  answer.Score as Score,
  question.Score as "Question score",
  question.ViewCount as "Question views",
  SUBSTRING(
    CONVERT(
      varchar(10), 
      convert(int,100000.0 * answer.Score / question.ViewCount)/1000.0
      ),
    0, 6) + '%' as Perct,
  question.FavoriteCount as "Favorite count",
  (case
    when answer.Id = question.AcceptedAnswerId Then 1
    else 0
    end) as Accepted
from
  Posts as answer
inner
  join 
    Posts as question
  on
    question.Id = answer.ParentID
where
  answer.ownerUserId = @UserId
Order by
  question.ViewCount DESC

queries.title: Average comment weight for posts.
queries.sql:
with comment_weight as (
select Score, Id, UserId, Creationdate, 
       case 
           when score is null then 0
           when score < @score_cap then score
           else @score_cap
       end score_weight,
       case
           when (len(Text) - @min_len)/@len_step < @len_cap 
                then (len(Text) - @min_len)/@len_step
           else @len_cap
       end length_weight
from Comments
where PostId in (@PostIds)
)

select avg(score_weight + length_weight + 0.0)
from comment_weight;

SELECT 
       comment.Id AS [Comment Link],
       commenter.DisplayName AS commenter,
       CASE
         WHEN pop.DisplayName IS NULL THEN NULL 
         ELSE op.DisplayName END
       AS answerer, CASE 
         WHEN pop.DisplayName IS NULL THEN op.DisplayName 
         ELSE pop.DisplayName END
       AS asker

FROM Comments AS comment
     JOIN Users AS commenter ON commenter.Id = comment.UserId
     JOIN (Posts AS opPost JOIN Users AS op ON op.Id = opPost.OwnerUserId)
  ON opPost.Id = comment.PostId
LEFT JOIN (Posts AS popPost JOIN Users AS pop ON pop.Id = popPost.OwnerUserId)
       ON popPost.Id = opPost.ParentId
       
WHERE commenter.Id  = @UserID
  AND op.Id        != @UserID
  AND (pop.Id       != @UserID OR pop.Id IS NULL)

ORDER BY comment.Id DESC

queries.title: Difference in score by delay between answers, if more than 30 days
queries.sql:
WITH  two_answers as (
  select min(a.Id) first, max(a.Id) last
  from Posts q
       join Posts a on q.Id = a.ParentId
  where q.AnswerCount = 2
  group by q.Id
  having getdate() - max(a.CreationDate) > 30
)

select min(datediff(hour, f.CreationDate, l.CreationDate)),
       avg(cast(isnull(f.Score, 0) as float)
            - cast(isnull(l.Score, 0) as float)) delta
from two_answers
     join Posts f on f.Id = first
     join Posts l on l.Id = last
where isnull(f.Score, 0) >= 0
      and isnull(l.Score, 0) >= 0
      and f.CreationDate < l.CreationDate
      and datediff(month, f.CreationDate, l.CreationDate) < 1
group by datediff(hour, f.CreationDate, l.CreationDate)
order by datediff(hour, f.CreationDate, l.CreationDate)

queries.title: View recent edits to tag wikis and excerpts
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @max_days_ago int = 180

SELECT
  u.Count,
  u.TagName,
  u.LastEditDate,
  u.LastEditorUserId AS [User Link],
  'site://edit-tag-wiki/'+CAST(u.Id AS varchar)+'|(edit)' AS [Edit],
  'site://posts/'+CAST(u.WikiPartId AS varchar)+'/revisions|('+u.Type+' hist)' AS [Hist]
FROM
  (SELECT t.Count, t.TagName, p.LastEditDate, p.LastEditorUserId, t.Id, 
          t.ExcerptPostId AS [WikiPartId], 'excerpt' AS [Type]
   FROM Tags AS t LEFT OUTER JOIN Posts p ON t.ExcerptPostId = p.Id
   UNION ALL
   SELECT t.Count, t.TagName, p.LastEditDate, p.LastEditorUserId, t.Id, 
          t.WikiPostId AS [WikiPartId], 'wiki' AS [Type]
   FROM Tags AS t LEFT OUTER JOIN Posts p ON t.WikiPostId = p.Id) AS u
WHERE
  DATEDIFF(DAY, u.LastEditDate, GETDATE()) < @max_days_ago
ORDER BY
  [LastEditDate] DESC

queries.title: All tables with column information.
queries.description: Simple but useful. Returns all tables in ASC order, along with all their columns in order, their data type name, character limit and whether it is nullable.
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  sys.tables.name AS [Table Name],
  sys.columns.name AS [Column Name],
  sys.columns.column_id AS [Column ID],
  sys.types.name AS [Data Type],
  sys.columns.max_length AS [Max Length],
  sys.columns.is_nullable AS [Nullable?]
FROM sys.columns 
  INNER JOIN sys.tables
    ON sys.columns.object_id = sys.tables.object_id
  INNER JOIN sys.types
    ON sys.types.user_type_id = sys.columns.user_type_id
ORDER BY sys.tables.name ASC, sys.columns.column_id ASC;

queries.title: Mean Expertise Contribution (MEC) in a tag
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @tag_debate float = 2.22;

with answers as (
  select a.OwnerUserId UserId,
         1.0/rank() over (partition by q.Id order by a.Score desc) utility,
         1.0*q.AnswerCount debatableness,
         1.0/rank() over (partition by q.Id order by a.Score desc) *
         q.AnswerCount/@tag_debate EC
  from Posts q
       join Posts a on q.Id = a.ParentId
       join PostTags on q.Id = PostId
       join Tags t on TagId = t.Id
  where TagName = @tag --and q.Id = 9929585
),

user_MEC as (
  select UserId as [User Link],
         sum(EC)/count(*) MEC,
         avg(utility) AU, 
         avg(debatableness) D,
         @tag_debate D_avg_t,
         count(*) Q_u_t
  from answers
  group by UserId  
)

select count(*)
from user_MEC

queries.title: Plots average answer score, +/- 1 standard deviation, as a function of binned answer length. Splits data into accepted vs. not accepted answers before doing so.
queries.description: Plots average answer score, +/- 1 standard deviation, as a function of binned answer length. Splits data into accepted vs. not accepted answers before doing so.

SELECT  AVG(LEN(A.Body)) as AverageLength,

queries.title: Get questions where title is same as body
queries.sql:
SELECT  TOP 10 p.Id AS [Post Link], p.Body, p.CreationDate
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM Posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 1
    AND LEN(Body) < LEN(Title) + 30
    AND LEN(Body) > LEN(Title)
) p
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT ph1.* FROM PostHistory ph1
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT PostId, MAX(CreationDate) AS CreationDate
    FROM PostHistory
    WHERE PostHistoryTypeId IN (2,5,8)
    GROUP BY PostId
  ) ph2
  ON ph1.PostId = ph2.PostId AND ph1.CreationDate = ph2.CreationDate
  WHERE PostHistoryTypeId IN (2,5,8)
) ph
ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE LOWER(p.Title) = LOWER(ph.Text)
ORDER BY CreationDate DESC

queries.title: Reputation < X in % of Total Users
queries.sql:
WITH  total_users AS (
SELECT
  tu_count = Count(*)
FROM
  Users
)
, users_rep_x AS (
SELECT
  ru_count = COUNT(*) 
FROM
  Users u
WHERE
  u.Reputation < @RepMax
)
SELECT
  DISTINCT 
    (SELECT tu_count FROM total_users) AS [Total Users],
    (SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x) AS [Users Rep > X],
    CAST( ( CAST( ( SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x ) AS decimal(10,5) ) / CAST( ( ( SELECT tu_count FROM total_users ) / 100 ) AS decimal(10,5) ) ) AS decimal(10,5) ) AS [RepU of TotU in %]
FROM
  Users u
WHERE
  u.Reputation < @RepMax

queries.title: Where are my questions answered with more votes than accepted answer
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  A.id as [Post Link],
  A.score,
  max(OA.score) as "other max score",
  CASE
      WHEN max(OA.score) - A.score > 0 THEN '***'
  END as "look here"
from
  Posts Q
  join Posts A on (A.id = Q.AcceptedAnswerId)
  left join Posts OA on (Q.id = OA.ParentId and OA.id != Q.AcceptedAnswerId)
where
  Q.OwnerUserId = @UserId
group by
  A.id, A.score
order by
  A.score ASC

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY
    
    sum(case when VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 else
    (case when VoteTypeId = 3 then -1 else 0 end)
    end)

    Users.Id AS [User Link],
     
    sum(case when VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 else
    (case when VoteTypeId = 3 then -1 else 0 end)

          INNER JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.id

    AND Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
    AND LOWER(Tags.TagName) = LOWER(@TagName)
GROUP BY
    Users.Id
ORDER BY
    CalcRep DESC;

queries.title: Question age distribution and average views
queries.sql:
WITH 
  post_age_and_views as (
    select
      id,
      cast(viewcount as float) as viewcount,
      datediff(minute, creationdate, GetDate()) / 1440.0 as age_in_days
    from posts
    where posttypeid = 1
  ),
  stats as (
    select
      cast(max(age_in_days) as float) as max_age,
      cast(count(1) as float) as num_posts,
      cast(max(viewcount) as float) as max_views
    from
      post_age_and_views
  ),
  binned as (
    select
      ceiling((age_in_days / s.max_age) / 0.05) as bin,
      viewcount
    from
      post_age_and_views
        join
      stats s on 1=1
  )
select
  bin,
  avg(viewcount) / max(max_views) as [Average view count (% of max)],
  count(*) / max(num_posts) as [Posts in bin (% of total)]
from
  binned
    join
  stats on 1=1
group by bin
order by bin asc
queries.sedeSql:

      datediff(minute, creationdate, GetDate()) / 1440.0 as age_in_days
    from posts
    where posttypeid = 1
  ),
  stats as (
    select
      cast(max(age_in_days) as float) as max_age,
      cast(count(1) as float) as num_posts,
      cast(max(viewcount) as float) as max_views
    from
      post_age_and_views
  ),
  binned as (

      ceiling((age_in_days / s.max_age) / 0.05) as bin,

  count(*) / max(num_posts) as [Posts in bin (% of total)]
from
  binned
    join
  stats on 1=1
group by bin
order by bin asc

queries.title: Most effective Illuminators with accept rate
queries.description: Illuminator badge holders ranked by their effectiveness; percentage of their answers that qualify for the badge times the number of qualifying answers. This gives a better ranking for how effectively people have improved the original question (how often they edited the question compared to the number of answers they gave).
queries.sql:
SELECT  ct AS [Total answers]
     , accept AS [Accepted answers]
     , accept * 100 / ct AS [Accept rate]
FROM (
   SELECT count(*) AS ct
         ,sum(CASE WHEN q.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accept
   FROM   Posts q 
   JOIN   Posts a on a.ParentId = q.Id
   WHERE  q.PostTypeId = 1 
   AND    a.ClosedDate IS NULL
   AND    q.ClosedDate IS NULL
   -- AND    a.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
   AND    a.PostTypeId = 2 
   AND    a.OwnerUserId = @UserId
   ) AS sub;

queries.title: total score of a tag
queries.description: http://meta.stackexchange.com/questions/242611/how-can-i-calculate-the-total-score-of-a-tag#242611
queries.sql:
SELECT  sum(upvote) as totup
, sum(downvote) as totdown
,  sum(upvote) *5 - sum(downvote)*2 as [score]
from (
   SELECT p.id
   , sum(case when v.votetypeid = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as upvote
   , sum(case when v.votetypeid = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as downvote
   from posts p
   inner join posttags pt on pt.postid = p.id
   inner join tags t on t.id = pt.tagid
   inner join votes v on v.postid = p.id
   where t.tagname= @tag
   and v.votetypeid in (2,3) -- upvote, downvote
   and p.posttypeid = 1 -- Q 
   group by p.id
) as basedata

queries.title: Average upvotes vs downvotes per post per month over time
queries.sql:
SELECT 
cast(CONCAT(y, '-', m, '-', '01') as date), (upvotes-downvotes)/numposts
from (
  SELECT year(CreationDate) as py, month(CreationDate) as pm, count(*) as numposts
  from Posts
  group by year(CreationDate), month(CreationDate)
) as p
join (
  SELECT
  y, m, SUM(upvote) as upvotes, SUM(downvote) as downvotes
  from (
    SELECT
    year(CreationDate) as y, month(CreationDate) as m, 0 as upvote, 1 as downvote
    from Votes
    where VoteTypeId=3
    union all
    SELECT
    year(CreationDate) as y, month(CreationDate) as m, 1 as upvote, 0 as downvote
    from Votes
    where VoteTypeId=2
  ) as allvotes
  group by y, m
) as v on p.py = v.y and p.pm = v.m
order by y, m

queries.title: The total number of questions asked so far vs. time?
queries.description: http://meta.stackexchange.com/questions/248396/how-can-i-get-stats-for-the-total-number-of-questions-asked-so-far-vs-time
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @Increments int = @p_Increments
-- Increments: Number of days per group "Default is 30"
DECLARE @Results int = @p_Results
-- Results: Number of groups to pull "Default is 12"

DECLARE @lowest datetime
select @lowest =  dateadd(d, - (@Increments * @Results), max(creationdate)) 
                 from posts;

select dateadd(d, days, @lowest) as [date]
     , sum(qcnt) over ( order by days) as Questions
     , sum(acnt) over ( order by days) as Answers
from (
    select
           datediff(m,  @lowest, creationdate) as days
         , sum(case when posttypeid=1 then 1 else 0 end) as qcnt
         , sum(case when posttypeid=2 then 1 else 0 end) as acnt
    from posts
    where creationdate >= @lowest
    group by datediff(m,  @lowest, creationdate)
   
    ) as counts

queries.title: Top users by median score

SELECT  Id, DisplayName, (
 (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM
   (SELECT TOP 50 PERCENT Score FROM Posts WHERE OwnerUserId = Users.Id ORDER BY Score) AS BottomHalf)

  FROM Posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId = Users.Id

ORDER BY MedianScore desc

DECLARE  @start date = dateadd(week, -1, getdate())

select
  p.Id as [Post Link], p.Score, p.AnswerCount, p.LastActivityDate, u.Id as [User Link], u.Reputation
from Posts as p
  join Users as u
    left join Posts as q
    on q.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  on u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
where p.PostTypeId = 1 -- question
and p.CreationDate >= @start
and p.Score > 2
and p.AcceptedAnswerId is null
and p.ClosedDate is null

 p.Id

,p.AnswerCount
,p.LastActivityDate

queries.title: Tags with most closed question (percentage)
queries.sql:
WITH  myTags as (
  select 
    t.TagName as Name,
    count(pt.TagId) as Total,
    (select count (p.Id) from Posts p
     inner join PostTags pt2 on pt2.TagId = t.Id
     where p.Id = pt2.PostId and p.ClosedDate is not null)
    as ClosedTotal
  from Tags t
  inner join PostTags pt on pt.TagId = t.Id
  group by t.TagName, t.Id
)

select
  t.Name as TagName,
  t.Total as Total,
  t.ClosedTotal as Closed,
  (100. * t.closedTotal / t.Total) as [%]
from myTags t
order by [%] desc

queries.title: First Question -> Good Question; How soon?
queries.sql:
SELECT  fp.owneruserid as [User Link], p1.id as [Post Link], p1.score
  , datediff(d, p1.creationdate, b.date) as DaysToGoodBadge
from
(
  SELECT p.owneruserid, min(p.creationdate) as dateFirstPost
  from posts p
  where p.posttypeid = 1
  group by  p.owneruserid
) fp
inner join posts p1
on p1.creationdate = fp.dateFirstPost
and p1.owneruserid = fp.owneruserid
and p1.score >= 25
inner join badges b
on b.userid = p1.owneruserid
and b.Name = 'Good Question'
order by datediff(d, p1.creationdate, b.date) asc

queries.description: This is a list of all answers for a user that count for the Explainer, Refiner and Illuminator badges, sorted by newest answer first.
queries.sql:
SELECT  YEAR(a.CreationDate) AS [Year],
       MONTH(a.CreationDate) AS [Month],
       COUNT(a.Id) AS [Count]
FROM Posts q
INNER JOIN Posts a ON q.Id = a.ParentId
WHERE q.PostTypeId = 1
  AND q.ClosedDate IS NULL
  AND a.PostTypeId = 2
  AND a.Score >= 1
  AND a.OwnerUserId = @userid
  AND (q.OwnerUserId IS NULL
       OR q.OwnerUserId <> a.OwnerUserId)
  AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM PostHistory ph
     WHERE ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4,5)
       AND ph.PostId = a.ParentId
       AND ph.UserId = a.OwnerUserId
       AND ABS(DATEDIFF(hh, ph.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)) < 12)
GROUP BY YEAR(a.CreationDate), MONTH(a.CreationDate)
ORDER BY YEAR(a.CreationDate) DESC, MONTH(a.CreationDate) DESC

queries.title: Inactive unanswered questions for specific tag
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @Time DATETIME = dateadd(dd, -@Days, getutcdate())
DECLARE @Pattern VARCHAR(25) = @Tag

SELECT Q.Id AS [Post Link] FROM
  Posts Q
  INNER JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.PostId = Q.Id
  INNER JOIN Tags ON Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId
WHERE
  patindex(@Pattern, Tags.TagName) != 0 AND
  Q.LastActivityDate < @Time AND
  Q.AcceptedAnswerId IS NULL AND
  Q.AnswerCount = (SELECT count(*) FROM Posts A WHERE 
    A.ParentId = Q.Id AND
    A.Score < 1 AND
    Q.LastActivityDate < @Time AND
    (SELECT count(*) FROM Comments WHERE
      Comments.PostId = A.Id AND Comments.CreationDate > @Time) = 0)
GROUP BY Q.Id, Q.LastActivityDate
ORDER BY Q.LastActivityDate DESC

  Users.Reputation,
  CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,1),COUNT(DISTINCT questions.Id))/CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,1),COUNT(DISTINCT answers.Id)) AS QuestionsPerAnswer

queries.title: How Quick Will My Rank Improve? Use this to find out if a small bump in reputation will leapfrog your rank.
queries.description: Use this to find out if a small bump in reputation will leapfrog your rank.
columns: Number of users in this range
queries.sql:
WITH  A(from1, blocksize)
as 
(
   select @reputation, power(10, floor(log10(@reputation) - 1)) --from users where displayname = @UserName
)
SELECT (reputation / blocksize) * blocksize 'Range start', count(*) 'Number of users in this range'
from users
inner join A on 1 = 1
where reputation > floor(from1 / blocksize) * blocksize
and reputation < (from1 + 100 * blocksize)
group by reputation / blocksize, blocksize

queries.title: R, Python and C++ Trends (# Questions per Tag per Month)
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
  'python', 'r', 'c++'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

DECLARE @To DATETIME = convert(DATETIME, @p_To)

queries.title: Questions with low score answers (from high rep users)
queries.description: Tries locating hidden gems by searching for answers by high rep users which has low score. To help decide score level it also lists max and average score on that question. It does however _not_ list the user, as we don't want to actually focus on the users when looking for hidden gems, but more to revisit and up-vote worthy answers.
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @reputationLimit AS INT = @p_ReputationLimit;
DECLARE @lowScoreLimit AS INT = @p_LowScoreLimit;
DECLARE @tag as NVARCHAR(60) = @p_Tag;

SELECT TOP (@Limit)
  u.Id AS [User Link],
  a.Id AS [Post Link],
  a.CreationDate,
  a.Score,
  q.MaxAns,
  q.AvgAns,
  q.Tags
FROM Posts a
  JOIN Users u ON a.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  JOIN (
  SELECT q.Id, q.Tags, AVG(a.Score) AvgAns, MAX(a.Score) MaxAns
    FROM Posts q
    JOIN Posts a ON a.ParentId = q.Id
    WHERE q.AcceptedAnswerId IS NULL
    GROUP BY q.Id, q.Tags
  ) q
  ON a.ParentId = q.Id
WHERE (u.Reputation > @reputationLimit)
  AND a.Score <= @lowScoreLimit
  -- AND q.MaxAnswerScore = 0
  AND (@tag = '' or q.tags like '%'+@tag+'%')
ORDER BY a.CreationDate DESC

queries.title: Ratio of questions with specific tag
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @BeginDate DATETIME = (SELECT min(CreationDate) FROM PostHistory);
DECLARE @EndDate DATETIME = (SELECT max(CreationDate) FROM PostHistory);
DECLARE @Pattern VARCHAR(25) = @TagPattern;

WITH Dates AS
(
  SELECT @BeginDate AS [DateValue]
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DateValue + 1 FROM Dates WHERE DateValue + 1 < @EndDate
)

SELECT D.DateValue AS [Date],

  (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Posts P 
    WHERE P.PostTypeId = 1 AND P.CreationDate < D.DateValue)
   THEN
    100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM Posts P 
      WHERE P.Tags LIKE @Pattern AND P.CreationDate < D.DateValue) / 
    (SELECT count(*) FROM Posts P 
      WHERE P.PostTypeId = 1 AND P.CreationDate < D.DateValue)
   ELSE 0 END) AS [SW %]
FROM
  Dates AS D
ORDER BY D.DateValue ASC
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 0)

queries.title: What percentage of down votes are users responsible for?
queries.sql:
WITH  DownVoteCount AS (
  SELECT DownVoteCount = CAST(SUM(DownVotes) AS float)
  FROM Users
 WITH the table's total downvote count
), DownVoteWeight AS (
  SELECT DisplayName, UpVotes, DownVoteWeight = ROUND(
            DownVotes / (SELECT DownVoteCount from DownVoteCount) * 100, 4
          ),
          DownVoteLikelihood = ROUND(
            DownVotes / CAST((DownVotes + UpVotes) AS float) * 100, 4
          )
  FROM Users
  WHERE Users.DownVotes > 0
)

SELECT DisplayName, DownVoteWeight, DownVoteLikelihood
FROM DownVoteWeight

ORDER BY DownVoteWeight DESC, UpVotes

SELECT  * FROM
(SELECT p.Id as [Post Link]
  , p.Score
  , SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UpVotes
  , SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DownVotes

FROM Posts p
 , Votes v
WHERE p.PostTypeId in (1,2) 
AND p.Id = v.PostId
AND p.CreationDate >= '2015-01-01'
group by p.Id, p.Score) AS VoteTally

INNER JOIN

(SELECT p.Id as [Post Link]
  , p.Score
 , sum(CASE WHEN f.VoteTypeId = 2  THEN 1 Else 0 End) AnonUpvotes  
 , sum(CASE WHEN f.VoteTypeId = 3  THEN 1 Else 0 End) AnonDownvotes

FROM Posts p
  ,  PostFeedback f
WHERE p.PostTypeId in (1,2) 
 AND p.Id = f.PostId 
AND p.CreationDate >= '2015-01-01'
group by p.Id, p.Score) AS AnonTally

ON AnonTally.[Post Link] = VoteTally.[Post Link]

DECLARE  @UserId int = @p_UserId

SELECT TOP 50
  p.Id AS [Post Link],
  COALESCE(p.LastEditDate,p.CreationDate) AS MostRecentChange,
  (
    Select Count(v.Id) 
    FROM Votes v
    INNER JOIN VoteTypes vt ON v.VoteTypeId = vt.Id
    WHERE vt.Name='UpMod' AND
      v.PostId = p.Id

FROM Posts p
INNER JOIN PostTypes pt ON pt.Id = p.PostTypeId
INNER JOIN Posts p2 ON p.ParentId = p2.Id
WHERE 
  pt.Name='Answer' AND
  p.OwnerUserId=@UserId AND
  p2.AcceptedAnswerId IS NULL
ORDER BY 
  p.Score, 
  p.LastEditDate DESC

WITH  tagscores AS (
    SELECT p.OwnerUserID as UserId,
    t.TagName,
    Count(p.Id) as NumAnswers,
    Sum(p.Score) AS TotalScore
    FROM Posts p
      INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON p.ParentID = pt.PostId
      INNER JOIN Tags t ON pt.TagId = t.Id
      INNER JOIN PostTypes py ON p.PostTypeId = py.Id
    WHERE
      t.TagName LIKE ('%' + @TagName + '%') AND
      py.Name = 'Answer' AND
      p.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
    GROUP BY t.TagName, p.OwnerUserID
    )
SELECT
Users.Id AS [User Link],
Users.Location,
Users.Reputation,
tagscores.TagName,
tagscores.NumAnswers,
tagscores.TotalScore
FROM Users
    INNER JOIN tagscores ON Users.ID = tagscores.UserID
WHERE Users.Location LIKE ('%' + @Location + '%')
ORDER BY tagscores.TotalScore DESC

queries.title: Get the percentage of closed questions for each tag with minimum tag popularity, excluding duplicates
queries.description: Get the percentage of closed questions for each tag, excluding duplicates. You can set the minimum tag popularity with a parameter.
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @min_total INT = @MinTotal;

SELECT *
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      t.TagName,
      Count(TagName) as Closed,
      t.Count as Total,
      ROUND(100.*Count(TagName)/t.Count,3) as [% Closed]
      FROM Posts p
      INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON p.Id = pt.PostId
      INNER JOIN Tags t ON pt.TagId = t.Id
      INNER JOIN PostHistory h ON p.Id = h.PostId
      WHERE
        (p.PostTypeId = 1) AND      -- match questions
        (p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL)  -- that have been closed at some point
       AND h.PostHistoryTypeId = 10      -- and have a history entry for it
       AND h.Comment NOT IN ('1', '101') -- that says it's not a dupe
      GROUP BY TagName, t.Count
  ) a
WHERE a.Total >= @min_total
ORDER BY
    [% Closed] desc, TagName

queries.title: Tags most associated with another, by year.
queries.description: Given a primary tag, and year, list the associated tags by popularity.
queries.sql:
SELECT  
  Tags.TagName AS [Tag Name], 
  COUNT(*) AS [Number of associated posts]
FROM PostTags
  INNER JOIN Tags
    ON Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId
WHERE 
  PostTags.PostId IN 
  (
    --Gets all the PostIds that have this tag
    SELECT DISTINCT PostId
    FROM PostTags
      INNER JOIN Tags
        ON Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId
      INNER JOIN Posts
        ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
    WHERE Tags.TagName = @TagName

queries.title: Search for posts which have attracted significantly more controversial or bad answers than good ones
queries.description: Search for posts which have attracted significantly more controversial or bad answers than good ones
queries.sql:
SELECT  p.Id as [Post Link], p.Score from (
SELECT p.ParentId, count(*) as ContACnt from (
    SELECT
      PostId,
      up = sum(case when VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 else 0 end),
      down = sum(case when VoteTypeId = 3 then 1 else 0 end)
    from Votes v join Posts p on p.Id = v.PostId
    where VoteTypeId in (2,3) and PostTypeId = 2
    group by PostId
  ) as ContA
  join posts p on ContA.PostId = p.Id
  where down > (up / @UVDVRatio) and (down + up) > @MinVotes
  group by p.ParentId
) as ContQ
join posts p on ContQ.ParentId = p.Id
where ContQ.ContACnt > (p.AnswerCount / 2) and p.AnswerCount > 1
order by Score desc

    from Votes v join Posts p on p.Id = v.PostId
    where VoteTypeId in (2,3) and PostTypeId = 2
    group by PostId
  ) as ContA
  join posts p on ContA.PostId = p.Id

queries.title: This query identifies all open Community-bumped posts that 1.) were bumped within the 30 days preceding the most recent Data Explorer import; and 2.) have been bumped more than once ever.
queries.description: This query identifies all open Community-bumped posts that 1.) were bumped within the 30 days preceding the most recent Data Explorer import; and 2.) have been bumped more than once ever.
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @last_extract AS datetime = (SELECT MAX(CreationDate) FROM PostHistory)

SELECT TOP 100
    ph.PostId AS [Post Link]
  , COUNT(*) AS [Count]
  , MAX(ph.CreationDate) AS [LastBump]
  , MAX(p.Score) AS [Score] -- MAX because we have a GROUP BY
  , MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS [AnswerCount]
FROM
  Posts AS p
  INNER JOIN PostHistory AS ph
    ON p.Id = ph.PostId
WHERE
  p.ClosedDate IS NULL
  AND ph.PostHistoryTypeId = 50
GROUP BY
  ph.PostId
HAVING
  MAX(ph.CreationDate) > DATEADD(DAY, -30, @last_extract)
  AND COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
  [Count] DESC

queries.title: Bumped Posts - New Answer Yet Unresolved
queries.sql:
SELECT  
        BH.*,
    'http://stackoverflow.com/questions/' + CONVERT(varchar,BH.PostID) + '/' AS PostLink,
        Posts.*
FROM
        (SELECT
                PH.PostId,
                MAX(PH.CreationDate) AS LastBump,
                COUNT(1) AS BumpCount,
                (SELECT Max(CreationDate) AS AnswerDate FROM Posts AP WHERE AP.ParentID=PH.PostId AND AP.Score=0) AS LastAnswer
        FROM
                PostHistory PH
        GROUP BY
                PostId) BH
LEFT JOIN
        Posts ON Posts.Id=BH.PostId
WHERE 
        Posts.AcceptedAnswerID IS NULL
        AND Posts.Score>=0
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Posts AP WHERE AP.ParentID=Posts.Id AND AP.Score>0)
        AND BH.BumpCount>1
ORDER BY
        BumpCount DESC,
        Score DESC

queries.title: Get a row of tag adjacency matrix with more than 10 posts
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @t_id int = (SELECT Id FROM Tags WHERE TagName = @tagName);

with TaggedPosts (PostId) as (
SELECT 
  PostID 
FROM 
  PostTags pt
WHERE 
pt.tagid = @t_id)

SELECT
  TagId, count(pt.PostId) as cnt
FROM 
  TaggedPosts tpos
  JOIN
  PostTags pt
  ON pt.PostId = tpos.PostId
WHERE
  pt.TagId != @t_id
GROUP BY TagId
HAVING count(pt.PostId) > 10
ORDER BY cnt DESC

DECLARE  @user varchar(50);
SELECT @user = @p_user;

-- startDate: YYYY-MM-DD
DECLARE @startDate DATETIME;

GROUP BY ROLLUP(pt.Name)

queries.title: Most popular StackOverflow tags in October 2016

SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as OctoberRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInOctober,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName

order by rate.rate desc
;

) AS t

       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as YearRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInYear,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId

order by rate.rate desc
;

queries.title: How many of my edits have been rolled back?
queries.description: Lists all of your posts where someone else performed a rollback after your edit. There could be some false positives here, where someone edited after you and the rollback just reverted their changes (and not yours).
queries.sql:
SELECT  DISTINCT
  edits.PostId AS [Post Link], 
  edits.Comment AS [Edit Comment],
  edits.CreationDate AS [Edit Date],
  rollbacks.Comment AS [Rollback Comment],
  rollbacks.CreationDate AS [Rollback Date]

FROM PostHistory edits
  INNER JOIN PostHistory rollbacks
    ON edits.PostId = rollbacks.PostId
    AND rollbacks.CreationDate > edits.CreationDate
WHERE 
  edits.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4,5,6)
  AND rollbacks.PostHistoryTypeId IN (7,8,9)
  AND edits.UserId = @UserId
  AND rollbacks.UserId <> @UserId

queries.title: Average answer score by the Log2 reputation of the answerer *at the time of the posting*
queries.description: This query groups the answers by the Log2 reputation of the answerer *at the time of posting the answer*. The reputation is not exact (counts the total answer score * 10), but nearly passes the truth. The horizontal line shows the Log2 Reputation! Thus, for example, 17 means reputation between 131072 and 262144!
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @AnswerNo INT;
SELECT @AnswerNo = COUNT(*)
FROM Posts
WHERE PostTypeId = 2;

WITH Raw AS (
  SELECT
    1.0 * Posts.Score AS Score,
    SUM(Posts.Score) OVER (
        PARTITION BY Users.Id
        ORDER BY Posts.CreationDate
        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS RunningScore
  FROM Posts, Users
  WHERE Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
    AND Posts.PostTypeId = 2
),
LogGroupedRaw AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(LOG(RunningScore * 10)/LOG(2) AS INT)
      AS LogReputation,
    Score
  FROM Raw
  WHERE RunningScore > 0
)
SELECT
  LogReputation,
  AVG(Score) AS AvgScore,
  100.0 * COUNT(*) / (COUNT(*)
FROM Posts
WHERE PostTypeId = 2) AS PctAnswers
FROM LogGroupedRaw
GROUP BY LogReputation
ORDER BY LogReputation
queries.sedeSql:

SELECT @AnswerNo = COUNT(*)
FROM Posts

        PARTITION BY Users.Id

        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS RunningScore
  FROM Posts, Users
  WHERE Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
    AND Posts.PostTypeId = 2
),
LogGroupedRaw AS (

queries.title: accept rate, for positive-scoring q/a, users with rep from elsewhere
queries.sql:
SELECT  

cast(sum(hasAccepted) as float) / count(acc.id) as ratio,
count(acc.id) as numQuestions,
sum(hasAccepted) as numAccepts

from

(
SELECT
  fq.id as id,
  case when sum(case when a.score > 0 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as hasPositiveAnswer,
  case when count(fq.accepted) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as hasAccepted
from
(
  SELECT 
    q.id as id,
    q.AcceptedAnswerId as accepted
  from posts q
  join users u
  on q.owneruserid = u.id
  where
    q.posttypeid = 1 and
    q.score > @minQScore and
    u.reputation > q.score * 5 + 1

) as fq
join posts a

cast(sum(hasAccepted) as float) / count(acc.id) as ratio,
count(acc.id) as numQuestions,
sum(hasAccepted) as numAccepts

from

(
SELECT
  fq.id as id,
  case when sum(case when a.score > 0 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as hasPositiveAnswer,
  case when count(fq.accepted) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as hasAccepted
from
(
  SELECT 
    q.id as id,
    q.AcceptedAnswerId as accepted
  from posts q
  join users u
  on q.owneruserid = u.id
  where

    q.score > ##minQScore?1## and
    u.reputation > q.score * 5 + 1

) as fq
join posts a
on fq.id = a.parentid
group by fq.id
) as acc
where hasPositiveAnswer > 0

queries.sql:
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(p.score) DESC) AS [#], 
    p.OwnerUserId AS [User Link], 
    Max(u.Reputation) as [Total Reputation],
    SUM(p.score) as [Tag Upvote],
    SUM(p.score)*10 + MAX(CASE q.AcceptedAnswerId
     WHEN p.Id THEN 15   
     ELSE 0  
     END) As [Tag Reputation],
     SUM(CASE q.AcceptedAnswerId
     WHEN p.Id THEN 1   
     ELSE 0  
     END) As [Accepted Answers],
    Count(p.id) as [Answers per Tag]

    LOWER(u.Location) LIKE LOWER(('%' + @CityName + '%'))
    AND p.posttypeid = 2 -- just answers
    AND q.tags like LOWER(('%<' + @TagName + '>%'))
GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
ORDER BY sum(p.score) DESC

queries.title: Most controversial users on the site
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Users.Id AS UserId,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Ups,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Downs
  FROM Votes, Posts, Users
  WHERE
    Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
    AND
    Votes.VoteTypeId IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY Users.Id
),
Ordered AS (
  SELECT
    UserId,
    Ups,
    Downs,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Ups DESC) AS UpRank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Downs DESC) AS DownRank
FROM Raw)
SELECT TOP 100
  UserId AS [User Link],
  Ups,
  Downs,
  UpRank,
  DownRank
FROM Ordered
ORDER BY UpRank + DownRank;

WITH  
T as (select 
          CASE
            WHEN Users.Location LIKE '%,%' THEN LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(RIGHT(location, Charindex(',', Reverse(Location))-1))))
            ELSE LOWER(RTRIM(LTRIM(Location)))
          END as loc,
      count(*) as 'count',
      sum(score) as 'score'
      from Posts
        INNER JOIN Users ON OwnerUserId = Users.id
        where Tags like ('%' + @TagNameInput + '%')
      group by Location ) 
select loc,
      sum(count) as total,
      sum(score) as score,

        when sum(count) = 0 and sum(score) = 0 then 0
        WHEN sum(count) = 0 and sum(score) > 0 THEN sum(score) 
        when sum(score) = 0 and sum(count) > 0 then 0
        else sum(score) * 1.0 / sum(count)
      END as 'degree'
from T group by loc order by score desc

queries.title: Questions where dupe is older as the original
queries.description: It doesn't count the rare cases as a question has multiple origs. Also it filters out as the orig and the dupe has the same OP or the same title.
queries.sql:
WITH  DupeRaw AS (
  SELECT
    Posts.Id AS PostId,
    MAX(PostHistory.Id) AS PostHistoryId
  FROM PostHistory, Posts
  WHERE
    PostHistory.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
    AND
    PostHistory.PostHistoryTypeId = 10
    AND
    Comment IN (1, 101)
  GROUP BY Posts.Id
),
Dupes AS (
  SELECT
    DupeRaw.PostId AS DupeId,
    JSON_VALUE(PostHistory.Text, '$.OriginalQuestionIds[0]') AS OrigId
  FROM DupeRaw, PostHistory
  WHERE
    DupeRaw.PostHistoryId = PostHistory.Id
)
SELECT
  Orig.Id AS [Post Link],
  Orig.CreationDate AS OrigPostDate,
  Dupe.Id AS [Post Link],
  Dupe.CreationDate AS DupePostDate
FROM Posts AS Orig, Dupes, Posts AS Dupe
WHERE
  Orig.Id = Dupes.OrigId
  AND
  Dupe.Id = Dupes.DupeId
  AND
  Orig.CreationDate > Dupe.CreationDate

WITH  DupeRaw AS (
  SELECT
    Posts.Id AS PostId,
    MAX(PostHistory.Id) AS PostHistoryId
  FROM PostHistory, Posts
  WHERE
    PostHistory.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
    AND
    PostHistory.PostHistoryTypeId = 10
    AND
    Comment IN (1, 101)
  GROUP BY Posts.Id
),
Dupes AS (
  SELECT
    DupeRaw.PostId AS DupeId,
    JSON_VALUE(PostHistory.Text, '$.OriginalQuestionIds[0]') AS OrigId
  FROM DupeRaw, PostHistory
  WHERE
    DupeRaw.PostHistoryId = PostHistory.Id
)
SELECT
  Orig.Id AS [Post Link],
  Orig.CreationDate AS OrigPostDate,
  Dupe.Id AS [Post Link],
  Dupe.CreationDate AS DupePostDate
FROM Posts AS Orig, Dupes, Posts AS Dupe
WHERE
  Orig.Id = Dupes.OrigId
  AND
  Dupe.Id = Dupes.DupeId
  AND
  Orig.CreationDate > Dupe.CreationDate

queries.title: Rolling 7-Day Count of Posters
queries.sql:
WITH  PostsPerDay as (
  select cast(CreationDate as Date) [Day]
  , OwnerUserId [User]
  , count(*) Post
from Posts
where CreationDate > '2017-07-01'

  where ppd.[Day] >= dateadd(dd, -7, PostsPerDay.[Day])
  and ppd.[Day] < PostsPerDay.[Day]

group by [Day], Rolling7DayCount
order by 1

queries.title: Python 2.x vs. Python 3.x - Number of Questions - Yearly Since 2013
queries.description: The goal of this query is to compare the trend of the number of Python 2 vs. Python 3 related questions. I started with 2012, because there were very few questions before that. For more information on the purpose of the query, see https://www.webucator.com/blog/2016/03/still-using-python-2-it-is-time-to-upgrade/.
queries.sql:
SELECT  left(t.TagName,8) AS Tag, YEAR(p.CreationDate) AS y,
COUNT(p.Id) AS NumPosts
FROM Tags t 
  JOIN PostTags pt ON pt.TagID = t.Id
  JOIN Posts p ON p.Id = pt.PostId
  WHERE (t.TagName LIKE '%python%')
  AND YEAR(p.CreationDate) >= 2013
GROUP BY left(t.TagName,8), YEAR(p.CreationDate)
ORDER BY y, Tag DESC
;

queries.title: Estimated reputation on a given day
queries.description: It calculates *only* the upvotes, downvotes and the accepted answers (by OPs). Doesn't count: bounties, acceptions (+2 for accepting an answer as OP), association bonus, -100 for rude/offensive/spam flags, +2 for edited posts, -1 for answer downvotes, and the rare cases as gained/lost rep remains on deleted posts.
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 1 THEN 15
    WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 2 AND Posts.PostTypeId = 1 THEN 5
    WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 2 AND Posts.PostTypeId = 2 THEN 10
    WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN -2
    WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 9 AND Votes.BountyAmount IS NOT NULL
    THEN Votes.BountyAmount
  END) AS EstimatedReputation
FROM Votes, Posts
WHERE
  Votes.VoteTypeId IN (1, 2, 3)
  AND
  Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
  AND
  Posts.OwnerUserId = @UserId
  AND
  Votes.CreationDate < @BeforeDate
  AND
  Posts.PostTypeId IN (1, 2)

queries.title: MVP - Pull Contribution (Based on User ID)
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  U.DisplayName as [Name],
  DATEPART(YEAR, P.CreationDate) as [Year],
  SUM(CASE WHEN P.PostTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as [Number of Answers],
  COUNT(P.Id) as [Number of Posts],
  CAST(SUM(P.Score) as decimal(6,2)) / COUNT(P.Id) as [Average Score],
  MAX(P.Score) as [Max Score],
  SUM(CASE WHEN P.PostTypeId = 2 THEN parent.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) as [Views of Answers]
FROM Posts P
inner join Users U on U.Id = P.OwnerUserId
left outer join Posts parent on parent.Id = P.ParentId
WHERE P.OwnerUserId = @UserId AND P.CreationDate >= @asOf
GROUP BY U.DisplayName, DATEPART(YEAR, P.CreationDate)

    Q.Id,
    MIN(Q.Score) AS QScore,
    COUNT(*) AS AnswerNo,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN A.Score < 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS NegAnswerNo
  FROM Posts Q, Posts A
  WHERE
    Q.Score < 0
    AND
    A.ParentId = Q.Id
    AND
    Q.AcceptedAnswerId IS NULL
    AND
    Q.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY Q.Id
)
SELECT Id AS [Post Link], QScore, AnswerNo, NegAnswerNo
FROM Raw
WHERE AnswerNo > 0 AND NegAnswerNo = AnswerNo
ORDER BY Id

  SELECT DATEDIFF(day, Posts.CreationDate, Votes.CreationDate) AS days
  FROM Posts, Votes
  WHERE
    Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Votes.VoteTypeId = 1
),
--SELECT AVG(days) FROM Raw
/*
SELECT days, LOG(1.0 * COUNT(*)) / LOG(10.0) AS logN
FROM Raw
GROUP BY days
ORDER BY days
*/
Raw2 AS (
  SELECT
    days,
    COUNT(*) AS N
  FROM Raw
  GROUP BY days
)
SELECT
  days,
  N,
  SUM(N) OVER (ORDER BY days ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS RunningTotal
FROM Raw2

queries.title: You vs competitor - Face to Face
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @UserId int = @p_UserId;
DECLARE @CompetitorId int = @p_CompetitorId;

with fights as (
  select myAnswer.ParentId as Question,
   myAnswer.Score as MyScore,
   jonsAnswer.Score as competitorsScore
  from Posts as myAnswer
  inner join Posts as jonsAnswer
   on jonsAnswer.OwnerUserId = @CompetitorId and myAnswer.ParentId = jonsAnswer.ParentId
  where myAnswer.ownerUserId = @UserId and myAnswer.postTypeId = 2
)

select
  case
   when myScore > competitorsScore then 'You win'
   when myScore < competitorsScore then 'Sorry'
   else 'Tie'
  end as 'Winner',
  Question as [Post Link],
  myScore as 'You',
  competitorsScore as "Not you"
from fights;

queries.title: You are in the top N% in your positively scored tags
queries.sql:
WITH  UserTagScore AS (
  SELECT
    A.OwnerUserId AS UserId,
    PostTags.TagId,
    SUM(A.Score) AS Score
  FROM
    Posts Q,
    Posts A,
    PostTags
  WHERE
    A.ParentId = Q.Id
    AND
    Q.Id = PostTags.PostId
  GROUP BY
    A.OwnerUserId,
    PostTags.TagId
  HAVING SUM(A.Score) > 0
),
UserNo AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS UserNo FROM Users
),
UserTagRank AS (
  SELECT
    UserId,
    TagId,
    Tags.TagName,
    Score,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TagId ORDER BY Score DESC) AS TagRank,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TagId) AS UserNumWITHTag
  FROM UserTagScore, Tags
  WHERE UserTagScore.TagId = Tags.Id
)
SELECT
  *,
  100.0 * TagRank / UserNumWITHTag AS TopPct
FROM UserTagRank
WHERE UserId = @AccountId

queries.title: Rank users by what fraction of their answers are accepted
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @MinAnswers int = @p_MinAnswers

SELECT
    TOP 100
    Users.Id AS [User Link],
    Count(*) as "Answers",
    Cast(Count(CASE WHEN q.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id THEN 1 END) as Float) / Count(*) AS "Fraction"
FROM Posts a
    INNER JOIN Posts q
        ON a.ParentId = q.Id
    INNER JOIN Users
        ON a.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
GROUP BY Users.Id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= @MinAnswers
ORDER BY "Fraction" DESC

queries.title: Number of Resolved Qs where solution is not the first A
queries.sql:
WITH  resolved_Qs as (
select Id as ResolvedQuestionId, AcceptedAnswerId, Score from Posts 
where PostTypeId = 1 and AnswerCount > 0
and AcceptedAnswerId is not null
),

topScores as (
select max(Score) as TopScore, ParentId as QuestionId from Posts
where PostTypeId = 2 and ParentId is not null
group by ParentId
),

topScorerAcceptedAs as (
select AcceptedAnswerId, ResolvedQuestionId, Score from resolved_Qs
inner join topScores on resolved_Qs.ResolvedQuestionId = topScores.QuestionId
where resolved_Qs.Score = topScores.TopScore
)


select
(select count(*)  from resolved_Qs) - (select count(*)  from topScorerAcceptedAs) as difference

union
select count(*)  from resolved_Qs

union
select count(*)  from topScores

queries.title: Most prolific answerers during date interval, mean answer score
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @EndDate datetime = (select case
  -- If we request 'today', actually use the date
  -- of the most recent transfer to this database,
  -- which may be as much as a week in the past.
  when @p_EndDate = 'today' then max(CreationDate)
  -- Otherwise, specify the most recent date to include.
  else @p_EndDate
  end
  from Posts
);
  
DECLARE @StartDate datetime = dateadd(day, -1*@DaysBack, @EndDate);

SELECT top (@HowManyUsers)
OwnerUserId as [User Link],
COUNT(*) as Answers,
Round(1.0 * count(*) / @DaysBack, 1) as 'Answers per day',
Round(1.0 * sum(Score) / Count(*), 2) as 'Mean Answer Score'
FROM Posts
WHERE CreationDate between @StartDate and @EndDate
  AND PostTypeId = 2 -- 1 for questions, 2 for answers
GROUP BY OwnerUserId
ORDER BY Answers DESC

queries.title: questions closed in last 10 days: who votes, why, and what was their rep?
queries.sql:
SELECT  
  ph.postid as [Post Link],
  q.creationdate,
  q.closeddate,
  format(cast(datediff(s,q.creationdate,q.closeddate) as decimal)/60,'0.0') as MinsToClose,

  cv.userid as [User Link],
  u.reputation as [UserReputation]
  
from 
  posts q

  join users u on u.id = cv.userid
  
where
  posthistorytypeid = 10 --closed
  and q.closeddate is not null --closed
  and q.creationdate >= dateadd(d,-10,getdate())  --temp:past 10 days
  and q.posttypeid = 1
  and q.score <= 0
  and q.answercount = 0

order by 
  ph.postid

  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId

queries.title: Breakdown of [Post History] records by type

DECLARE  @totalRecords int = (select count(*) from posthistory)

select
  row_number() over (order by count(ph.id) desc) as Rank,
  pht.id,
  name as [Post History Type],
  format(count(ph.id),'#,##0') as [#],
  case when 1.0*count(ph.id)/@totalRecords<.005 then '<1%' else 
     format(1.0*count(ph.id)/@totalRecords,'0%') end as [%],
  format(min(ph.creationdate),'yyyy-MM-dd') as Earliest,
  format(max(ph.creationdate),'yyyy-MM-dd') as Latest
from posthistory ph join posthistorytypes pht on ph.posthistorytypeid = pht.id
group by name, pht.id
order by count(ph.id) desc

queries.title: Tags Count per Day for 2018
queries.sql:
WITH  Tags_CTE
AS
(
SELECT _Date, REPLACE(REPLACE(_Tags,'<',''),'>','') as _Tag, count(*) as _Count
FROM
	(
		SELECT a.Id as _ID, CAST(a.creationdate as date) as _Date, a.Title as _Title, value as _Tags
		FROM Posts a
		CROSS APPLY 
		STRING_SPLIT(REPLACE(a.Tags,'><',','),',')
		WHERE a.creationdate >= '2018-01-01'-- AND a.creationdate < '2018-08-01'
	) Tags_CTE
GROUP BY _Date, REPLACE(REPLACE(_Tags,'<',''),'>','')
)
SELECT _Tag, SUM(_Count) _AUG_2018_Count
FROM Tags_CTE
GROUP BY _Tag
ORDER BY 2 DESC

queries.title: Decadist badge: Collected at least 200 rep from post votes in each year of the last 10
queries.description: Not exact, we can't count a lot of things affecting the reputation, but it is about roughly this. Check this [meta discussion](https://meta.stackoverflow.com/q/374646/1783163).
queries.sql:
WITH  VoteRep AS (
  SELECT 1 AS VoteTypeId, 2 AS PostTypeId, 15 AS Rep
  UNION
  SELECT 2 AS VoteTypeId, 1 AS PostTypeId, 5 AS Rep
  UNION
  SELECT 2 AS VoteTypeId, 2 AS PostTypeId, 10 AS Rep
  UNION
  SELECT 3 AS VoteTypeId, 1 AS PostTypeId, -2 AS Rep
  UNION
  SELECT 3 AS VoteTypeId, 2 AS PostTypeId, -2 AS Rep
),
Raw AS (
  SELECT
    VoteRep.Rep,
    Posts.OwnerUserId AS UserId,
    DATEDIFF(yy, Votes.CreationDate, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS Age
  FROM Posts, Votes, VoteRep
  WHERE
    Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Votes.VoteTypeId = VoteRep.VoteTypeId
    AND
    Posts.PostTypeId = VoteRep.PostTypeId
)
SELECT SUM(Rep) AS Rep, Age, UserId
FROM Raw
GROUP BY UserId, Age
HAVING SUM(Rep) >= 200

queries.title: How many questions were re-tagged in the last 3 months?
queries.description: I hope you realize that every tag-based report or query on any SE site, is based largely on what often-self-proclaimed-clueless-OPs decide to randomly tag their question.... ;)
queries.sql:
SELECT  distinct postid as id
into #tagsedited from posthistory
where PostHistoryTypeId=6 
 and creationdate >=dateadd(MM,0-@MonthsBack,getdate())

SELECT 
  q.id as qID, 
  e.id as eID
into #q from posts q left outer join #tagsedited e on q.id=e.id
where
  q.creationdate >=dateadd(MM,0-@MonthsBack,getdate())
  and q.posttypeid=1
  
SELECT
  count(1) as [# Questions],
  sum(case when eID is not null then 1 else 0 end) as [# Re-tagged],
  format(1.0*sum(case when eID is not null then 1 else 0 end)/count(1),'0%') as [% Re-tagged]
from #q

queries.title: Delay between question and answer in answered questions for Beam / Dataflow

queries.title: Lists all users which answered the same questions as I did and compare the scores
queries.description: Lists all users which answered the same questions as I did and compare the scores
queries.sql:
SELECT  oa.OwnerUserId AS [User Link]
     , COUNT(*) AS [Total Answers]
     , SUM(IIF(qu.AcceptedAnswerId = ma.Id, 1, 0)) AS [MA Accepted]
     , SUM(IIF(qu.AcceptedAnswerId = oa.Id, 1, 0)) AS [OA Accepted]
     , NULLIF(SUM(IIF(qu.AcceptedAnswerId = ma.Id, 1, 0)), 0)
     / NULLIF(SUM(IIF(qu.AcceptedAnswerId = oa.Id, 1, 0)), 0) * 100.0 AS [Ratio]
     , SUM(ma.Score) AS [MA Total Score]
     , SUM(oa.Score) AS [OA Total Score]
     , NULLIF(SUM(ma.Score), 0)
     / NULLIF(SUM(oa.Score), 0) * 100.0 AS [Ratio]
FROM       Posts AS ma
INNER JOIN Posts AS qu ON ma.ParentId = qu.Id
INNER JOIN Posts AS oa ON qu.Id = oa.ParentId AND ma.Id <> oa.Id
WHERE ma.PostTypeId = 2
AND ma.OwnerUserId = @UserId
AND oa.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY oa.OwnerUserId

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 1)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc

queries.description: https://chat.stackexchange.com/transcript/message/49612762#49612762
queries.sql:
SELECT  A.Count as 'Votes', COUNT(*) as 'Count', ROUND(COUNT(*) / (CAST(B.Total AS float)) * 100, 5) as '%age'

FROM 

(SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS 'Count'
  FROM Posts
    JOIN Votes
    ON Votes.PostId = Posts.Id

  FROM Posts

queries.title: Q:A ratio for top users
queries.sql:
SELECT  Id AS [User Link], Reputation,
  CASE Questions
    WHEN 0 THEN '1:infinity'
    ELSE '1:' + CAST(ROUND(Answers / CAST(Questions AS FLOAT), 2) AS NVARCHAR)
  END AS 'Q:A ratio'
  FROM

(SELECT TOP 50 u.Id, u.Reputation,
SUM(CASE p.PostTypeId WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Questions',
SUM(CASE p.PostTypeId WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 'Answers'
  FROM Users AS u
  INNER JOIN Posts AS p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
  GROUP BY u.Id, u.Reputation
  ORDER BY u.Reputation DESC) AS temp

queries.title: Count of first-posts per week
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    DATEADD(dd,
      7 * FLOOR(DATEDIFF(day, '1970-01-05', CreationDate) / 7),
      '1970-01-05') AS PostWeek,
    Id
  FROM Posts
  WHERE Id IN (
    SELECT MIN(Id) FROM Posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId
  )
)
SELECT
  PostWeek,
  COUNT(*) AS Count
FROM Raw
GROUP BY PostWeek
ORDER BY PostWeek;

queries.title: Mean rep gained by answers by count of earlier answers
queries.sql:
WITH  PostNo AS (
  SELECT
    Id AS PostId,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ParentId ORDER BY Id) AS N
  FROM Posts
  WHERE
    ParentId IS NOT NULL
),
VoteRep AS (
  SELECT 1 AS VoteTypeId, 15 AS Rep
  UNION
  SELECT 2, 10
  UNION
  SELECT 3, -2
),
Raw AS (
  SELECT
    PostNo.PostId,
    SUM(VoteRep.Rep) AS Rep,
    MIN(PostNo.N) AS N
  FROM PostNo, Votes, VoteRep
  WHERE
    Votes.PostId = PostNo.PostId
    AND
    VoteRep.VoteTypeId = Votes.VoteTypeId
  GROUP BY PostNo.PostId
)
SELECT
  N,
  COUNT(*) AS Count,
  AVG(1.0 * Rep) AS Rep
FROM Raw
GROUP BY N
ORDER BY N
queries.sedeSql:

  UNION

  UNION

),
Raw AS (

queries.title: Number of Posts closed as duplicates
queries.sql:
WITH  stub_list AS
(SELECT p.Id,
        p.Score,
        pl.RelatedPostId -- Post Destination (master)
 FROM Posts p
 JOIN PostLinks pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id
 WHERE p.PostTypeId = 1 -- questions.
       AND EXISTS 
       (
        SELECT *
        FROM PostHistory ph
        WHERE ph.PostId = p.Id
        AND ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (10) -- Post Closed (duplicate)     
      )
      AND pl.LinkTypeId = 3 -- duplicate.
)
SELECT COUNT(s.Id) AS 'closed as duplicate'
FROM stub_list s
JOIN Posts p ON p.Id = s.RelatedPostId  -- p is the "original" Post of which s is a duplicate

  ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, Users.ID) AS rnCount

queries.description: Multiple self answers from asker, sorted by the number of times self-answered, and filtered to exclude questions prior to Jan 1, 2010. (To avoid questions from 2008 with historical locks.)
queries.sql:

       question.CreationDate,
       count(selfAnswer.Id) as [Count]
from posts as question
    inner join posts as selfAnswer
        on  selfAnswer.owneruserid = question.owneruserid
        and selfAnswer.parentid = question.id
        inner join Users as users on users.Id = question.owneruserid
where question.posttypeid = 1
and selfAnswer.posttypeid = 2
--and question.CommunityOwnedDate is null
group by question.Id, 
         question.CreationDate
having count(distinct selfAnswer.id) > 0
order by

queries.title: Age-normalised score per answer with minimum answer count (ranking; non-CW)
queries.sql:
SELECT  top (@RankedUsers)
  rank() over (order by R.Ratio desc) as Rank, R.Id as [User Link], R.Ratio
from (
SELECT U.Id, 100 * sum(cast(A.Score as real) / datediff(day, A.CreationDate, getdate())) / count(A.Score) as Ratio
  from Posts A
  inner join Users U on U.Id = A.OwnerUserId
  where A.PostTypeId = 2
    and A.CommunityOwnedDate is null
  group by U.Id
  having count(A.Id) >= @MinimumAnswerCount
  ) R
order by R.Ratio desc

queries.title: Users with a specified reputation on two sites
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) =
'SELECT ''https://' + @site1 + '.stackexchange.com/u/''
  + CAST(u1.Id AS NVARCHAR) + ''|'' + u1.DisplayName AS ''User'',
  u1.Reputation AS ' + @site1 + ',
  u2.Reputation AS ' + @site2 + '
  FROM [StackExchange.' + @site1 + '].dbo.Users AS u1
  INNER JOIN [StackExchange.' + @site2 + '].dbo.Users AS u2
    ON u1.AccountId = u2.AccountId
    WHERE u1.Reputation >= ' + CAST(@reputation AS NVARCHAR) + '
      AND u2.Reputation >= ' + CAST(@reputation AS NVARCHAR) + '
  ORDER BY u1.Reputation + u2.Reputation DESC';
EXEC(@sql);

queries.title: User post activity history by year of registration

  SELECT
    DATEFROMPARTS(
      DATEPART(yyyy, Posts.CreationDate),
      DATEPART(m, Posts.CreationDate),
      1) AS PostMonth,
    DATEPART(yyyy, Users.CreationDate) AS UserYear,
    COUNT(*) AS Count
  FROM Posts, Users
  WHERE
    Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id

      DATEPART(m, Posts.CreationDate),
      1),
    DATEPART(yyyy, Users.CreationDate)
)
SELECT PostMonth, CAST(UserYear AS VARCHAR(MAX)), Count
FROM Raw
ORDER BY PostMonth, UserYear

queries.title: Most viewed posts with tags became synonyms
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT TagName
  FROM Tags
  
  INTERSECT
  
  SELECT SourceTagName AS TagName
  FROM TagSynonyms
  WHERE ApprovalDate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT TOP 20000
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Posts.ViewCount DESC) AS N,
  Posts.Id AS [Post Link],
  Posts.ViewCount,
  'site://tags/' + TagSynonyms.SourceTagName + '|' + TagSynonyms.SourceTagName
    AS SourceTag,
  'site://tags/' + TagSynonyms.TargetTagName + '|' + TagSynonyms.TargetTagName
    AS TargetTag
FROM Raw, Tags, PostTags, TagSynonyms, Posts
WHERE
  Raw.TagName = Tags.TagName
  AND
  Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId
  AND
  PostTags.PostId = Posts.Id
  AND
  Raw.TagName = TagSynonyms.SourceTagName
ORDER BY
  Posts.ViewCount DESC, Posts.Id

queries.title: Produces a histogram of the number of users involved in closing questions as a duplicate (ruling out OP-accepted duplicates and gold-badge closures) over the past three years
queries.description: Produces a histogram of the number of users involved in closing questions as a duplicate (ruling out OP-accepted duplicates and gold-badge closures) over the past three years

COUNT(*)
FROM

) AS counts

ORDER BY NumberOfUsersClosing

queries.title: Upvotes on question - distribution over vote age
queries.sql:
SELECT  Age, [2010], [2011], [2012], [2013], [2014], [2015], [2016], [2017], [2018], [2019]
FROM

(SELECT YEAR(p.CreationDate) AS [Year],
  DATEDIFF(YEAR, p.CreationDate, v.CreationDate) AS Age,
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT(p.Id)) AS Upvotes
  FROM Votes AS v
  INNER JOIN Posts AS p
    ON v.PostId = p.Id
  WHERE v.VoteTypeId = 2
    AND p.PostTypeId = 1
  GROUP BY YEAR(p.CreationDate),
  DATEDIFF(YEAR, p.CreationDate, v.CreationDate)
  ) AS temp

PIVOT (
AVG(Upvotes)
  FOR Year IN ([2010], [2011], [2012], [2013], [2014], [2015], [2016], [2017], [2018], [2019])
) AS pivotTable

ORDER BY Age

queries.title: Days to Close a Question by Creation Month
queries.sql:
SELECT  date1, AVG(diff1) as cnt
FROM (

  SELECT 
    DATEDIFF(day, d.CreationDate, d.ClosedDate) as [diff1],
    FORMAT (d.CreationDate, 'yy-MM') as [date1],
    FORMAT (d.ClosedDate, 'yy-MM') as [date2],
    (d.Id) as id
  FROM Posts d  -- d=duplicate
    LEFT JOIN PostHistory ph ON ph.PostId = d.Id
    LEFT JOIN PostLinks pl ON pl.PostId = d.Id
    LEFT JOIN Posts o ON o.Id = pl.RelatedPostId  -- o=original
  WHERE
    d.PostTypeId = 1  -- 1=Question
    AND ph.PostHistoryTypeId = 10  -- 10=Post Closed
    
  ) as t1
group by date1
order by date1

WITH  USER_BY_TAG
AS
(
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) Rank,
        u.Id AS [User Link], 
        COUNT(*) AS UpVotes
    FROM Tags t
        INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON pt.TagId = t.id
        INNER JOIN Posts     p ON p.ParentId = pt.PostId
        INNER JOIN Votes     v ON v.PostId = p.Id and VoteTypeId = 2
        INNER JOIN Users     u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
        WHERE 
            LOWER(Location) LIKE '%malaysia%'
            AND  TagName = 'android'
        GROUP BY u.id, TagName
)

SELECT * FROM USER_BY_TAG WHERE rank <= 1000 ORDER BY upvotes DESC ;

queries.title: Average gained rep by questions and answers
queries.description: It counts only accept/up/down votes on not deleted posts. PostTypeId = 1 means a question. PostTypeId = 2 means an answer.
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  AVG(1.0 *
    CASE
      WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 1 THEN 15
      WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN -2
      WHEN Posts.PostTypeId = 1 THEN 5
      ELSE 10
    END) AS Rep,
  Posts.PostTypeId
FROM Posts, Votes
WHERE
  Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
  AND
  Votes.VoteTypeId <= 3
  AND
  Posts.PostTypeId <= 2
GROUP BY Posts.PostTypeId

queries.title: Count of first-posts by month
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  DATEFROMPARTS(
    DATEPART(yyyy, CreationDate),
    DATEPART(mm, CreationDate),
    1) AS Month,
    COUNT(*) AS Count
FROM Posts
WHERE Id IN (
  SELECT MIN(Id) AS Id
  FROM Posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId > 0
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
)
GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(
  DATEPART(yyyy, CreationDate),
  DATEPART(mm, CreationDate),
  1)
ORDER BY Month DESC;

queries.title: List of all moderator election nominations, network-wide
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    LAG(CreationDate) OVER (ORDER BY CreationDate) AS PrevCrDate,
    Id,
    CreationDate
  FROM Posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 6
)
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        PrevCrDate IS NULL
        OR
        DATEDIFF(day, PrevCrDate, CreationDate) > 30
      THEN
        1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) OVER (
    ORDER BY CreationDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS ElectionId,
  Raw.Id AS PostId,
  CreationDate
FROM Raw
ORDER BY CreationDate

queries.title: Most common mutual questioner - answerer pairs
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Q.OwnerUserId AS QId,
    A.OwnerUserId AS AId,
    COUNT(*) AS Count
  FROM Posts Q, Posts A
  WHERE
    A.ParentId = Q.Id
    AND
    A.OwnerUserId > 0
    AND
    Q.OwnerUserId > 0
    AND
    A.OwnerUserId <> Q.OwnerUserId
    AND
    Q.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
    AND
    A.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
  GROUP BY Q.OwnerUserId, A.OwnerUserId
)
SELECT
  Hin.QId AS [User Link],
  Hin.AId AS [User Link],
  Hin.Count AS HinCount,
  Her.Count AS HerCount
FROM Raw Hin, Raw Her
WHERE
  Hin.AId = Her.QId
  AND
  Hin.QId = Her.AId
  AND
  Hin.QId > Hin.AId
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN Hin.Count > Her.Count THEN Her.Count
    ELSE Hin.Count
  END DESC, Hin.QId, Hin.AId
queries.sedeSql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Q.OwnerUserId AS QId,
    A.OwnerUserId AS AId,
    COUNT(*) AS Count
  FROM Posts Q, Posts A
  WHERE
    A.ParentId = Q.Id
    AND
    A.OwnerUserId > 0
    AND
    Q.OwnerUserId > 0
    AND
    A.OwnerUserId <> Q.OwnerUserId
    AND
    Q.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
    AND
    A.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
  GROUP BY Q.OwnerUserId, A.OwnerUserId
)
SELECT
  Hin.QId AS [User Link],
  Hin.AId AS [User Link],
  Hin.Count AS HinCount,
  Her.Count AS HerCount
FROM Raw Hin, Raw Her
WHERE
  Hin.AId = Her.QId
  AND
  Hin.QId = Her.AId
  AND
  Hin.QId > Hin.AId
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN Hin.Count > Her.Count THEN Her.Count
    ELSE Hin.Count
  END DESC, Hin.QId, Hin.AId

queries.title: Selects all posts where the number of upvotes is greater than the number of downvotes, but where the number of downvotes is at least half the number of upvotes. The result is ordered by the number of upvotes (the highest on top).
queries.description: Selects all posts where the number of upvotes is greater than the number of downvotes, but where the number of downvotes is at least half the number of upvotes. The result is ordered by the number of upvotes (the highest on top).
queries.sql:
SELECT  concat('https://stackoverflow.com/a/', PostId), Upvotes, Downvotes
from (
    SELECT PostId, Upvotes, Downvotes, 2 * Downvotes / nullif(Upvotes, 0) as Ratio
    from (
        SELECT
            PostId, 
            Upvotes = sum(case when VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 else 0 end),
            Downvotes = sum(case when VoteTypeId = 3 then 1 else 0 end)
        from Votes
        where VoteTypeId in (2,3)
        group by PostId
    ) as VoteCounts inner join Posts on Posts.Id = VoteCounts.PostId
    where Upvotes > 0 and Downvotes > 0
) as Scores
where Ratio >= 1
order by Upvotes desc

queries.title: Usernames used in possible comment replies to posts by a deleted user
queries.sql:
WITH  texts_cte as
(
SELECT DISTINCT c.Text AS Text
FROM Comments c JOIN Posts p ON (c.PostId=p.Id)
  AND (p.OwnerDisplayName='user' + Convert(nvarchar(20), @UserId)) 
WHERE (c.Text LIKE '%@%')
)
, substrings_cte AS
(
SELECT substring(Text,charindex('@',Text), len(Text)) AS TextFrom
FROM texts_cte
),
names AS
(
SELECT substring(TextFrom,1,patindex('%[ :,.]%',TextFrom+' ')-1) AS Reply
FROM substrings_cte
)

SELECT Reply, Count(*) AS Count
FROM Names
GROUP BY Reply
ORDER BY Count(*) DESC

queries.title: closed edited and reopened questions
queries.sql:
WITH  closed_and_edited AS (
SELECT c.PostId, MIN(e.CreationDate) AS EditDate
  FROM PostHistory AS c
  INNER JOIN PostHistory AS e
    ON c.PostId = e.PostId
   AND c.PostHistoryTypeId = 10 -- Post Closed
   AND e.PostHistoryTypeId = 5 -- Edit Body
   WHERE c.CreationDate < e.CreationDate
  GROUP BY c.PostId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Closed and edited',
  COUNT(oa.PostId) AS 'Closed, edited and reopened',
  ROUND(COUNT(oa.PostId) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS '%'
  FROM closed_and_edited AS q
  OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT PostId
      FROM PostHistory
      WHERE PostId = q.PostId
        AND PostHistoryTypeId = 11 -- Post Reopened
        AND CreationDate >= q.EditDate
  ) oa

queries.title: mean score in 30 days for questions and answers
queries.sql:
WITH  a as
(
   select [Month], PostTypeId, Score,
           SUM(case when VoteTypeId = 2 then 1.00 when VoteTypeId = 3 then -1.00 else 0.00 end) quickVotes
   from Votes v 
   join
   (   Select CAST(cast(DATEPART(YYYY, CreationDate) as float) + cast(DATEPART(MM, CreationDate) as float)/12 as float) [Month], 
          Score, Id, CreationDate, AnswerCount, PostTypeId from Posts
   ) p 
       on p.Id = v.PostId 
       where DATEDIFF(day, p.CreationDate, v.CreationDate)
             BETWEEN 0 AND 30
       and p.PostTypeId in (1)
   group by [postId], [Month], PostTypeId, Score
) 

select [Month],
       sum(quickVotes) SumAfterMonth, 
       avg(quickVotes) ScoreAfterMonth,
       avg(Score*1.00) ScoreTotal
from a
group by [Month], PostTypeId
order by PostTypeId,[Month]

queries.title: Most popular StackOverflow tags in 2019
queries.sql:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as YearRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInYear,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate <= '2019-12-31'
and Posts.CreationDate >= '2019-01-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 10)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as YearRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInYear,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate <= '2019-12-31'
and Posts.CreationDate >= '2019-01-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName

queries.title: Best time for an answer
queries.sql:
WITH tmp AS(
  SELECT TimeDiff = DATEDIFF(minute, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate),
         Period = ROUND((CAST(DATEPART("weekday", q.CreationDate) AS numeric) +
                         CAST(DATEPART("hour", q.CreationDate) AS numeric) / 24), 2)
  FROM Posts q
     LEFT OUTER JOIN Posts a ON q.AcceptedAnswerId = a.Id
     WHERE q.AcceptedAnswerId > 0 AND 
           q.CreationDate > DATEADD("year", -@YearsBack, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  )
  SELECT Period,
         ROUND(AVG(CAST(TimeDiff AS FLOAT)), 2) AS [Average time-to-answer, minutes, UTC (GMT)]
FROM tmp
   WHERE ABS(TimeDiff) < @MaxTimeDiff
   GROUP BY Period
   ORDER BY Period

queries.title: Most related, correlated or anticorrelated tags
queries.description: Calculates the correlation coefficient between all tag pairs. 0 correlation means that the tags are independent from each other. Negative correlation means that having a tag makes unlikely to have the other tag. Positive correlation means that a question tagged with one of them, makes likely to be tagged by the other.
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @TotalQ INT;

SELECT @TotalQ = COUNT(*) FROM Posts WHERE PostTypeId = 1;

WITH Raw AS (
  SELECT
    A.TagId AS TagA,
    B.TagId AS TagB,
    COUNT(*) AS Count
  FROM PostTags A, PostTags B
  WHERE
    A.PostId = B.PostId
    AND
    A.TagId <> B.TagId
  GROUP BY A.TagId, B.TagId
)
SELECT TOP 100
  A.TagName AS TagNameA,
  A.Count AS CountA,
  B.TagName AS TagNameB,
  B.Count AS CountB,
  Raw.Count AS BothCount,
  (1.0 * Raw.Count * @TotalQ - 1.0 * A.Count * B.Count)
    /
    SQRT(1.0
      * A.Count * (@TotalQ - A.Count)
      * B.Count * (@TotalQ - B.Count))
    AS Corr
FROM Tags A, Tags B, Raw
WHERE
  Raw.TagA = A.Id
  AND
  Raw.TagB = B.Id
  AND
  A.Count > 5
  AND
  B.Count > 5
  AND
  A.TagName < B.TagName
ORDER BY Corr DESC;
queries.sedeSql:
DECLARE  @TotalQ INT;

SELECT @TotalQ = COUNT(*) FROM Posts WHERE PostTypeId = 1;

WITH Raw AS (
  SELECT
    A.TagId AS TagA,
    B.TagId AS TagB,
    COUNT(*) AS Count
  FROM PostTags A, PostTags B
  WHERE
    A.PostId = B.PostId
    AND
    A.TagId <> B.TagId
  GROUP BY A.TagId, B.TagId
)
SELECT TOP 100
  A.TagName AS TagNameA,
  A.Count AS CountA,
  B.TagName AS TagNameB,
  B.Count AS CountB,
  Raw.Count AS BothCount,
  (1.0 * Raw.Count * @TotalQ - 1.0 * A.Count * B.Count)
    /
    SQRT(1.0
      * A.Count * (@TotalQ - A.Count)
      * B.Count * (@TotalQ - B.Count))
    AS Corr
FROM Tags A, Tags B, Raw
WHERE
  Raw.TagA = A.Id
  AND
  Raw.TagB = B.Id
  AND
  A.Count > 5
  AND
  B.Count > 5
  AND
  A.TagName < B.TagName
ORDER BY Corr DESC;

queries.title: Longest time between consecutive edits by days
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(Id) AS Id,
    MIN(PostId) AS PostId,
    RevisionGUID,
    MIN(CreationDate) AS CreationDate
  FROM PostHistory
  WHERE PostHistoryTypeId <= 6
  GROUP BY RevisionGUID
),
Raw2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PostId ORDER BY Id) AS No
  FROM Raw
)
SELECT TOP 100
  Prv.PostId AS [Post Link],
  Prv.CreationDate AS Edit1,
  Nxt.CreationDate AS Edit2,
  1.0 * DATEDIFF(s, Prv.CreationDate, Nxt.CreationDate) / 86400 AS DayDiff
FROM Raw2 Prv, Raw2 Nxt
WHERE
  Prv.PostId = Nxt.PostId
  AND
  Prv.No + 1 = Nxt.No
  AND
  Prv.CreationDate < Nxt.CreationDate
ORDER BY DayDiff DESC, Prv.Id
