queries.title: Ratio of reputation estimated by votes got, vs. real reputation
queries.description: We calculate the rep of the users by counting only the up/down/accept votes (so: no bounty, edits, -100 for rudeness, 1 rep limit, community owned posts, -1 for answer downs, no rep for most deleted posts, and no rep for self-answer accepts). Then we see the distribution, how this estimated reputation relates to the real reputation of the users.
queries.sql:
WITH  VoteRep AS (
  SELECT 1 AS VoteTypeId, 15 AS Rep
  UNION
  SELECT 2, 10
  UNION
  SELECT 3, -2
),
Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Users.Id,
    1.0 * SUM(VoteRep.Rep) / MIN(Users.Reputation) AS EstRep,
    MIN(Users.Reputation) AS Reputation
  FROM Users, Posts, Votes, VoteRep
  WHERE
    Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
    AND
    Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Votes.VoteTypeId = VoteRep.VoteTypeId
  GROUP BY Users.Id
),
Raw2 AS (
  SELECT Id, 1.0 * EstRep/Reputation AS RatioRaw
  FROM Raw
)
SELECT
  FLOOR(RatioRaw/0.01)*0.01 AS Ratio,
  COUNT(*) AS Count
FROM Raw2
GROUP BY RatioRaw/0.01
ORDER BY Ratio

queries.title: Logarithmic vote distribution by month
queries.sql:
DECLARE  @Ts DATETIME;

SELECT @Ts = DATEFROMPARTS(
  YEAR(MAX(Votes.CreationDate)),
  MONTH(MAX(Votes.CreationDate)),
  1)
FROM Votes;

SELECT
  DATEFROMPARTS(
    YEAR(Votes.CreationDate),
    MONTH(Votes.CreationDate),
    1) AS Month,
  MIN(VoteTypes.Name) AS VoteType,
  LOG(COUNT(*))/LOG(2) AS Log2Count
FROM Votes, VoteTypes
WHERE
  Votes.VoteTypeId = VoteTypes.Id
  AND
  Votes.CreationDate < @Ts
GROUP BY
  DATEFROMPARTS(
    YEAR(Votes.CreationDate),
    MONTH(Votes.CreationDate),
    1),
  Votes.VoteTypeId
ORDER BY Month DESC, Log2Count DESC

queries.title: Top 100 users with very similar tag score distribution to you
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Posts.OwnerUserId AS UserId,
    PostTags.TagId,
    SUM(5 - 2 * Votes.VoteTypeId) AS Score
  FROM Posts, Votes, PostTags
  WHERE
    Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Votes.VoteTypeId BETWEEN 2 AND 3
    AND
    Posts.PostTypeId = 2
    AND
    Posts.ParentId = PostTags.PostId
    AND
    Posts.OwnerUserId > 0
  GROUP BY Posts.OwnerUserId, PostTags.TagId
)
SELECT TOP 100 *
FROM Raw You
FULL JOIN Raw Other ON Other.TagId = You.TagId
WHERE
  You.UserId = @SiteAccountId
  AND
  Other.UserId <> You.UserId
ORDER BY Other.UserId, COALESCE(You.TagId, Other.TagId)

queries.title: Most popular StackOverflow tags in April 2020
queries.sql:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as PeriodRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInPeriod,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2020-05-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2020-04-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
queries.sedeSql:

       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as PeriodRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,

       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2020-05-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2020-04-01'

queries.title: Distribution of post frequency by users
queries.sql:
SELECT 
   c.post_count
  ,c.cum_posts
  ,100.0* c.cum_posts / max(c.cum_posts) 
     over (order by c.post_count desc) cum_posts_pctg
  ,c.cum_users
  ,100.0* c.cum_users / max(c.cum_users) 
     over (order by c.post_count desc) cum_users_pctg
from(
  SELECT
    b.post_count
   ,1.0*sum(b.post_count) over (order by b.post_count desc) 
      as cum_posts
   ,1.0*sum(b.users_having_post_count) over (order by b.post_count desc) 
      as cum_users
  from (
    SELECT 
       a.post_count
      ,count(a.user_id) as users_having_post_count
    from (
      SELECT
         OwnerUserId as user_id
        ,count(Id) as post_count
      from Posts
      where OwnerUserId is not null
      group by OwnerUserId
    ) as a
    group by a.post_count
  ) as b
) as c
order by 1 desc
;

queries.title: after how many hours after the first nomination of that election was in
queries.description: after how many hours after the first nomination of that election was in
queries.sql:
WITH  nominations as 
(select row_number() over(order by creationdate asc) num
      , creationdate
from posts
where posttypeid = 6
)

select *
into #nominations
from nominations

select f.num
     , f.creationdate
     , datediff(
         d
       , coalesce(
          (select creationdate 
           from #nominations
           where num = f.num -1)
          , f.creationdate)
       , f.creationdate) [diff]
into #nom_diff
from #nominations f
order by f.num

select row_number() over(order by num) [election]
     , *
into #elections
from (
select *
from #nom_diff
where num = 1
union
select *
from #nom_diff
where diff > 7
) data

select *
from #elections

) tuser ON tuser.UserId = us.Id

ORDER BY Score DESC;

queries.title: Number of questions asked by a group of users in 30 days
queries.sql:
WITH  Questions AS (
  SELECT Id, OwnerUserId, Score, CreationDate
    FROM Posts  
    WHERE OwnerUserId IN (SELECT VALUE FROM STRING_SPLIT(@UserIDs, ','))
)
SELECT q.Id AS [Post Link], q.OwnerUserId AS [User Link], q.Score, q.CreationDate,
  COUNT(*) AS '# of Qs in 30 days'
  FROM Questions AS q
  INNER JOIN Questions AS q2
    ON DATEDIFF(DAY, q2.CreationDate, q.CreationDate) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
  GROUP BY q.Id, q.OwnerUserId, q.Score, q.CreationDate
  ORDER BY q.CreationDate DESC

queries.title: Distribution of the owners of the Epic badge by their estimated rep at the time of getting the badge
queries.sql:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Posts.OwnerUserId AS [User Link],
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 1 THEN 15
        WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 10
        ELSE -2
      END
    ) AS EstRep
  FROM Posts, Votes, Users, Badges
  WHERE
    Badges.Name = 'Epic'
    AND
    Badges.TagBased = 0
    AND
    Badges.UserId = Users.Id
    AND
    Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
    AND
    Posts.PostTypeId BETWEEN 1 AND 2
    AND
    Posts.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
    AND
    Posts.Id = Votes.PostId
    AND
    Votes.VoteTypeId BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    AND
    Votes.CreationDate < Badges.Date
  GROUP BY Posts.OwnerUserId
)
SELECT
  1000 * FLOOR(0.001 * EstRep) AS EstRepK,
  COUNT(*) AS Count
FROM Raw
GROUP BY 1000 * FLOOR(0.001 * EstRep)
ORDER BY EstRepK

queries.title: Shows the tag scores and per-tag post counts for a given user, with the top 9 tags _by non-CW post count_ selected for showing on the profile page, then ordered by tag score.
queries.description: Shows the tag scores and per-tag post counts for a given user, with the top 9 tags _by non-CW post count_ selected for showing on the profile page, then ordered by tag score. The top six of these actually make it to the profile page. There are parameters to alter the post-count cutoff point and a flag to enable counting Community Wiki posts in the per-tag post counts. The defaults for these are what is actually used, but playing with these settings can help understanding the algorithm better.
queries.sql:
WITH  by_post_count AS (
  SELECT
    t.TagName AS Tag
  , COUNT(a.Id) AS [Post Count]
  , SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (a.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS Score
  , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.Id) DESC) AS post_count_rank
  FROM Posts a
  INNER JOIN Posts q     ON q.Id = a.ParentId
  INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON pt.PostId = q.Id
  INNER JOIN Tags t      ON t.Id = pt.TagId
  WHERE
      a.OwnerUserId = @userid
  GROUP BY t.TagName
)
SELECT
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Score DESC)
, Tag
, Score
, [Post Count]
FROM by_post_count
WHERE post_count_rank <= 9
ORDER BY Score DESC;
queries.sedeSql:

  SELECT
    t.TagName AS Tag
  , COUNT(a.Id) AS [Post Count]
  , SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN (a.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS Score
  , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.Id) DESC) AS post_count_rank
  FROM Posts a
  INNER JOIN Posts q     ON q.Id = a.ParentId
  INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON pt.PostId = q.Id
  INNER JOIN Tags t      ON t.Id = pt.TagId
  WHERE

)
SELECT

FROM by_post_count
WHERE post_count_rank <= 9

queries.title: How can I find all the self-answers available on Stack Overflow? How popular are self-answers? How often has the answer been split up due to the 30000 character space constraint and because the user has a lot more to talk about? Do self-answers often attract additional answers from other users?
queries.description: https://meta.stackoverflow.com/questions/400772 How popular are self-answers? How often has the answer been split up due to the 30000 character space constraint and because the user has a lot more to talk about? Do self-answers often attract additional answers from other users?
queries.sql:
WITH  self_q as
(
select q.id
     , max(len(a.body)) [max len]
     , (select count(*) 
        from posts p
        where p.parentid = q.id
        and p.owneruserid = q.owneruserid) [num_self]
from posts q 
inner join posts a on a.parentid = q.id
where q.owneruserid = a.owneruserid  
and q.posttypeid = 1 
and q.owneruserid is not null
and q.owneruserid > -1
group by q.id, q.owneruserid
)

select count( q.id) [self answer]
     , sum(q.answercount) [# answers]
     , sum(case when q.answercount = 1 then 1 else 0 end) [only OP answered]
     , sum(case when [max len] > 29000 then 1 else 0 end) [large answers]
     , sum(case when [num_self]>1 then 1 else 0 end) [OP more then one answer]
from posts q 
inner join self_q on self_q.id = q.id

  WHERE PostHistoryTypeId = 2

queries.title: Suggested edits with review time
queries.sql:
SELECT  TOP 1000 pt.Name, p.Id AS [Post Link],
  'site://suggested-edits/' + CAST(se.Id AS NVARCHAR) AS 'Suggested edit',
  ROUND(DATEDIFF(SECOND, se.CreationDate, COALESCE(ApprovalDate, RejectionDate)) / 86400., 2)
    AS 'Review time (days)'
  FROM SuggestedEdits AS se
  INNER JOIN Posts AS p
    ON se.PostId = p.Id
  INNER JOIN PostTypes AS pt
    ON p.PostTypeId = pt.Id
  WHERE COALESCE(ApprovalDate, RejectionDate) IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY COALESCE(ApprovalDate, RejectionDate) DESC

queries.title: Time to first answer by minutes (self-answers excluded)
columns: Number of questions answered within x minutes
queries.sql:
SELECT  DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate),
  COUNT(*) AS 'Number of questions answered within x minutes'
  FROM Posts AS q
  CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 OwnerUserId, CreationDate
      FROM Posts
      WHERE ParentId = q.Id
        AND CreationDate >= q.CreationDate
      ORDER BY CreationDate
  ) a
  WHERE q.OwnerUserId != a.OwnerUserId
  GROUP BY DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)
  ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)
queries.sedeSql:

  COUNT(*) AS 'Number of questions answered within x minutes'

      FROM Posts
      WHERE ParentId = q.Id
        AND CreationDate >= q.CreationDate
      ORDER BY CreationDate
  ) a
  WHERE q.OwnerUserId != a.OwnerUserId
  GROUP BY DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)

queries.title: Tags ordered by average question score (non CW)
queries.sql:
SELECT 
  RANK() OVER(ORDER BY AVG(CAST(q.SCORE AS decimal)) DESC) AS Rank,
  t.Tagname,
  AVG(CAST(q.Score AS decimal)) AS [Average Score],
  COUNT(q.Id) AS Count,
  SUM(q.Score) AS [Total Score]
FROM Posts q INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON q.Id=pt.PostId
  INNER JOIN Tags t ON t.id = pt.TagId
WHERE (q.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL)
GROUP BY t.Tagname
ORDER BY AVG(CAST(q.SCORE AS decimal)) DESC
